digest.component_or_area: CLI mutating verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, create, transition, etc.)
propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, etc.) exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from writes; agents must run follow-up show commands to verify writes, causing duplicate queries and spurious retries on misread results.

Success confirmations must follow kubectl/git-style stdout output: one-line past-tense verb + args summary (e.g. 'linked <src> -> <target> (<relation>)') built only from CLI args and seam outcome, with no-ops reporting 'no change: <reason>' and both exiting 0.

Global --quiet and --output flags must be extracted uniformly at the top-level router before partition dispatch, enabling all verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves to support --quiet (text confirmation only), --output json (single JSON envelope with outcome field), and preserving byte-identical REDIRECT records.

Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must normalize to the shared confirmation contract with zero information loss, preserving all emitted data (e.g. transition's UNBLOCKED ids retained in the normalized line).

Consumed seam returns (add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; CLI derives confirmation only from exposed signals, never altering the type or meaning of values consumed by MCP/library facades.

Confirmations print to stdout; logs/warnings to stderr; confirmations omitted when REDIRECT records print (sole stdout result per invocation); redirect records emit byte-identically before/after including under --quiet.
